title: Talking About Biography and New Beginnings
summary: Narrating biography and discussing how something started or changed.
whyItMatters: A coherent biography selects relevant milestones, explains turning points, and connects past decisions to the present.

mentalModel.title: Milestone, reason, consequence
mentalModel.content: For each important event, explain what happened, why it mattered, and what followed.

mentalModel.title: Use a clear timeline
mentalModel.content: Guide the listener with dates, age, sequence markers, and changes of place or role.

ruleBlocks.title: Introduce the person and focus
ruleBlocks.content: State who the person is and why their story is relevant.

ruleBlocks.title: Connect milestones
ruleBlocks.content: Use zuerst, danach, später, einige Jahre lang, schließlich, and seitdem.

ruleBlocks.title: Highlight turning points
ruleBlocks.content: Use Damals entschied sie, Das änderte sich, als, or Dadurch begann.

examples.de: Nora Weber wurde 1985 in Hamburg geboren und wuchs dort auf.
examples.en: Nora Weber was born in Hamburg in 1985 and grew up there.

examples.de: Nach der Ausbildung arbeitete sie mehrere Jahre in einem großen Unternehmen.
examples.en: After training she worked for several years in a large company.

examples.de: Das änderte sich, als sie den Laden ihrer Tante übernahm.
examples.en: That changed when she took over her aunt's shop.

commonMistakes.wrong: Use und then for every event.
commonMistakes.correct: Vary sequence, duration, cause, and turning-point expressions.
commonMistakes.reason: Different connectors show how events relate.

commonMistakes.correct: Select details that explain development or change.

comparisons.summary: The theme supplies milestones, roles, and business vocabulary.
The passive highlights current processes and responsibilities.
